verses.gurmukhi: ੧੧ : ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦਾ ਫਰਕ ਗੁਣਾ ਕਰਕੇ
verses.translit_en: 11 : gurmukh manmukh dhaa farak gunaa karake

en.bdb: Different qualities of Gurmukh and Manmukh

verses.gurmukhi: ਥੋਮ ਕਥੂਰੀ ਵਾਸੁ ਜਿਉ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਲੋਹੁ ਨਹੀਂ ਇਕ ਵੰਨਾ।
verses.translit_en: thom kathooree vaas jiau ka(n)chan loh nahee(n) ik va(n)naa|

en.bdb: As the smell of the garlic and musk is different, the gold and iron are also not the same.

verses.gurmukhi: ਫਟਕ ਨ ਹੀਰੇ ਤੁਲਿ ਹੈ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਨੜੀ ਨ ਵੜੀਐ ਗੰਨਾ।
verses.translit_en: faTak na heere tul hai samasar naRee na vaReeaai ga(n)naa|

en.bdb: Glass crystal is not equal to diamond and likewise, the sugarcane and a hollow reed are not the same.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਰਤਨਾ ਰਤਕਾ ਮੁਲਿ ਨ ਕਚੁ ਵਿਕਾਵੈ ਪੰਨਾ।
verses.translit_en: tul na ratanaa ratakaa mul na kach vikaavai pa(n)naa|

en.bdb: Red and black seed (rata) is not equal to jewel and glass cannot sell at the price of emerald.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਘੁੰਮਣ ਵਾਣੀਐ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਬੰਨਾਂ।
verses.translit_en: dhuramat ghu(n)man vaaneeaai gurmat sukirat bohith ba(n)naa(n)|

en.bdb: Evil intellect is a whirlpool but the wisdom of Guru (gurmat) is the ship of good deeds that takes across.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਹੋਵੇ ਬੁਰੇ ਦੀ ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰ ਭਲੇ ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨਾ।
verses.translit_en: ni(n)dhaa hove bure dhee jai jai kaar bhale dha(n)n dha(n)naa|

en.bdb: Evil person is always condemned and the good person is applauded by all.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸਚੁ ਰਹੈ ਪਰਛੰਨਾ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh paragaT jaaneeaai manmukh sach rahai parachha(n)naa|

en.bdb: Through the gurmukhs, the truth becomes manifest and thus is known by one and all, but in the manmukhs, the same truth is pressed and concealed.
Like a broken pot, it is of no use.
